title: Restriction on the left argument of the symplectic form
statement: Let $p$ be prime, $\bbf_p$ the field with $p$ elements, and let $V = \bbf_p^n \times \bbf_p^n$ carry the symplectic form $\omega\big((x,z),(x',z')\big) = \sum_{i=0}^{n-1}(x_i z'_i - z_i x'_i)$. For a subset $M \subseteq \{0,\dots,n-1\}$, let $r_M : V \to V$ be the endomorphism that keeps the coordinates indexed by $M$ and sets all others to zero, and let $V_M \subseteq V$ be the subspace of vectors whose support is contained in $M$. Then for every $s \in V$ and every $v \in V_M$, \[ \omega\big(r_M(s),\, v\big) = \omega(s, v). \]
hypotheses_covered: M a subset of the index set Fin n
s an arbitrary vector in V
v is supported on M (v ∈ V_sub M)
replaced: If $v \in V_M$, then $\omega(r_M^V(s), v) = \omega(s, v)$ for all $s \in V$.
